summary: @lyxa.ai/core bootstrap routes event-bus traffic through hardcoded author-owned CloudAMQP broker with embedded credentials
details: dist/index.js registerLibraries unconditionally calls initEventBus with a hardcoded amqps URL containing inline username and password: amqps://adlvedna:<redacted>@dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com/adlvedna. Consumers that invoke the exported bootstrapCore() have all publishEvent and subscribeToEvent traffic routed through this author-controlled CloudAMQP vhost with no way to override the destination. Because the AMQP credentials are embedded in the published tarball, any reader of the package can also connect to the same vhost and publish messages that the installer's subscribeToEvent handlers will consume, providing an inbound injection path into the installer's event handlers. Separately, dist/libraries/configuration/index.js ships four full Firebase Admin RSA private keys with clientEmails for lyxa-core@for-poc-325210.iam.gserviceaccount.com, lyxa-user, lyxa-rider (project lyxa-rider-88939) and lyxa-shop as _defaultOptions consumed by ConfigurationService when the caller does not override firebaseAdmin options; those credentials authorize access to the author's own GCP tenants.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
